observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (1555 x 2508) blurred 3x3, whole with a 0.05 grid and four crops at 0.02; read for the floor's shape, not against a render
covers: the floor from above at the left wall's foot, aft of GA-3: the wall's plain lower skirt, the raised ledge along its foot with its round bosses and pressed patch, the diagonal slope at the ledge's aft end, the round bolted floor hatch, the olive plate, the bulkhead's foot and the wedge box
notes: session A (9A33BM2/BM3, not identified; same interior session as g097-g100). Orientation: top of the photo is the left wall, the photo's left is aft (the rear bulkhead), the bottom is the aisle. So the ledge's long edge runs along the vehicle and the hatch lies inboard of it. Not a flat plate: the floor has at least two levels here, a raised ledge along the left wall and a lower deck with the hatch. How high the ledge stands is not measurable from this view; the bright rim along its edge and the shadow line above it are all that show it. The light is one flash near the lens, so shading gives the relief's sense only.

details.what: the left wall's plain lower skirt under the rack's foot: flat grey sheet, nothing fixed to it but the blue pipe, the cream cable and one small stud
details.size_cue: about as tall in the image as a cannon plug is long
details.note: g099-d d01 is this skirt from lower down

details.what: the blue pipe and the cream sleeved cable run along the skirt on spaced P-clips, above the wall's foot
details.size_cue: the clips about as wide as the bolts on the hatch

details.what: the foot of the skirt where it turns onto the ledge: a pale band with a grime-dark trough just inboard of it
dark greasy dirt in a band along the ledge's wall side, thickest in the middle

the raised ledge along the left wall's foot: a flat-topped strip running along the vehicle from the frame's right edge aft to the diagonal slope, its inboard edge a bright bent rim with a small notch and a dark line beyond it
details.size_cue: the strip about three round bosses wide (d08)
details.note: the same edge is g099-d d05; the model's floor is a flat plate

details.what: a small step or notch in the ledge's inboard rim, where the bright bent edge ends and a thin dark line carries on forward
a rectangular pressed or welded patch in the ledge at the head of the slope, outlined by faint lines, its middle rough and stippled
details.size_cue: about one and a half bosses wide

details.what: three round bosses in the ledge's top, each a hex bolt in a raised ring with a dark crescent where its ring is proud
details.size_cue: each boss about two hatch bolts across

details.what: a diagonal dark crease from the ledge's wall end down and aft to the box's corner: the ledge's aft end is cut off by a slope down onto the deck
the slope aft of that crease: a big plain light plate, roughly a four-sided trapezoid, from the wall's foot to the bulkhead's foot and the wedge box, brighter where it faces the flash
details.size_cue: about as wide across as the wedge box is long
details.note: whether it rises to the wall or falls away from it is not certain; the crease is its low side on the evidence of the shadow

details.what: a large round bolted cover in the deck, seen at a slant, inboard of the ledge; the outer edge marked by a dark bead that runs round beyond the bolts
details.size_cue: about twice the wedge box's width across
details.note: the dark line may be a gasket's bead or a thin wire lying on the floor; the part behind the tray is hidden

details.what: seven large flange bolts with washers round the cover; more are hidden by the tray
details.size_cue: each head about as wide as the cream cable

details.what: a shallow pressed oval inside the bolt circle: the cover's dished centre, its ring just catching the flash, a rust stain at its aft side
an olive-brown plate on the deck under GA-3's pedestal, its aft corner rounded, darker than the grey deck
details.size_cue: about as wide across the vehicle as the ledge

details.what: two small rivets on the plate and two larger flange bolts at its corner
a short bright bar on the deck just aft of the plate, a turned-up sheet's lit edge
a thin straight seam across the deck from the plate's aft corner: the joint between two deck plates, the upper edge of the bright strip
the bulkhead's foot: the wall's dark sealed crease against the deck, running away from the box down the photo's left
the bulkhead's lower face, stained dark and scratched, seen foreshortened from above
the deck along the bulkhead's foot, between it and the tray: lighter, worn and scuffed, marks of a walkway
a blue-grey wedge-shaped box against the bulkhead, on the deck at the slope's aft corner, its top face sloped, a spring on its upper hinge, black gap round it
details.size_cue: about as long as the tray is wide
details.note: g100-c d11 (0.69-0.93, 0.76-0.94); a short mention only

details.what: a black rubber foot or knob standing on the deck between the wedge box and the hatch
the open sheet tray across the foreground (a folded seat's stowage or a box's lid, not part of the floor) hides the hatch's near third
the deck's general finish: matt grey-green paint, scuffed bare along the hatch's rim, a rust spot at the far right
details.note: the model's floor plate is a flat colour
